BiblicalUsage: Giddalti is a person named 2 times in Scripture, in 1 Chronicles. No People profile carries this name, so I note the name’s use here and go no further.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Giddalti matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
